svg.title: Your PC and the ways to reach a Windows VM
svg.desc: Check your Windows PC first, with winver and dsregcmd /status, then pick a client. Remote Desktop Connection (mstsc) and Windows App can both reach a plain Windows virtual machine over RDP on TCP port 3389. The web browser client is crossed out because it only works for Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 and Dev Box. The VM vm-azb-win01 is drawn dashed because you create it in Lab 12. Microsoft Entra ID is shown below: your PC and the VM must be in the same directory, unless you use the web account setting.
